name: Pin & Pan Smash (Combat, Style)
body:
You can parry and deliver a powerful bash with your pan, stunning your adversaries.

Prerequisites(s): Improved Shield Bash, Pin & Pan Style, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +7.

Benefit(s): When using Pin & Pan Style, you can use an attack with your battle pan to disrupt an opponent’s attack. This functions as a swashbuckler‘s opportune parry and riposte deed, except that if you score a critical hit on your attack roll to parry, you also smash your opponent right in the face, inflicting normal damage (not critical) and stunning it for the next round.
